Class PaymentServiceImpl

java.lang.Object
com.me.learning.rental.service.PaymentServiceImpl
All Implemented Interfaces:
PaymentService
@Service @Transactional(readOnly=true) public class PaymentServiceImpl extends Object implements PaymentService
Default implementation of PaymentService.

Transaction strategy

  • Class-level @Transactional(readOnly = true) covers all read paths.
  • Write methods override with @Transactional (read-write).

Rental association

PaymentRequestDto.rental() may optionally carry the ID of an existing Rental. On create/update the rental is loaded from RentalRepository, ensuring we set a JPA-managed entity reference rather than a detached one created by MapStruct.
